raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Fig. 1 target volume fraction f",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The numerical volume fraction for this particular example is not specified.",
      "readings": [
        "f = 0.30",
        "f = 0.40",
        "f = 0.50"
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 2, Fig. 1 and Eq. (4) identify only the symbol f; Sec. 5.1 supplies a dataset range of 30–50% without identifying this example's value."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Discrete application of the corner load",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The corner arrow identifies the nominal load location, but the boundary-element description does not specify how the force is assigned to finite-element nodes.",
      "readings": [
        "Apply the entire downward force to the bottom-right corner node.",
        "Divide the downward resultant equally between the two nodes of the bottom edge of the corner element.",
        "Divide the downward resultant equally between the two nodes of the right edge of the corner element."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Fig. 1 places the arrow at the bottom-right corner; Sec. 5.1 chooses a boundary element as the load location without describing its nodal force assignment."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The paper does not identify whether the two-dimensional elasticity calculation uses plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress with E = 1 and Poisson's ratio 0.3.",
        "Plane strain with E = 1 and Poisson's ratio 0.3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 2, Eqs. (1)–(3), specifies elastic stiffness without a constitutive reduction; Sec. 5.1 gives Young's modulus and Poisson's ratio but no plane-stress or plane-strain assumption."
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Density-filter weight metric",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The filter equation uses differences between symbols defined as densities, leaving unclear whether these are literal density differences or intended spatial distances.",
      "readings": [
        "Within the spatial neighborhood, use the literal weights w_ei = 2 - |x_i - x_e| based on density differences.",
        "Use spatial weights w_ei = 2 - ||r_i - r_e|| for element centroids separated by less than two element spacings."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 2 defines x_e as element density, then uses |x_i - x_e| in Eq. (6) while describing nearby elements; Sec. 5.1 specifies a density-filter radius of 2.0."
    }
  ]
}
